lines.opening: Hello, this is the virtual assistant calling from Ferncliff Lending.
lines.robot: Yes, I am an automated assistant.

lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have confirmed that I am speaking with the right person.

lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble, I must have the wrong number.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss, and sorry to have troubled you.

lines.id_declined: I understand, but I can't continue without the security questions.
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match the details we hold.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't confirm your identity, so I can't continue this call. Please contact Ferncliff Lending directly.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your account with us.

lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full {amount} today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay everything in full today?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, the lowest amount I can accept for your {name} is {floor}.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm afraid that amount is still too low.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day; the next business day is {date}.
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day could you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, that would be {amount} on {date}.
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest possible date is {date}, so that date applies.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your payment promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the payment promise could not be recorded because of a technical problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know; our team will check the payment on your account.
lines.dispute_line: Thank you, our team will look into this and get back to you.
lines.hardship: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll put you through to our Care team now, who can help.
lines.restructure_line: I'll put you through to our Plans desk, who can discuss a payment plan with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with before I transfer you?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise can't be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding at the moment.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: Later full-amount steps are not skipped after 'too much'; each step is offered unless it repeats an earlier offer.

assumptions: Today is 2026-10-11, before memo FL-OPS-26-11 (dated 30 October 2026). Following the pack's order of authority ('the earlier text still applies to calls before that date'), the base spec holds the COL-POL-07 values. The memo's items 1, 2 and 4 are dated changes from 2026-10-30: band A deadline becomes the 5th business day, holidays drop 2026-11-13 and add 2026-11-30, and the overdraft floor becomes 20%. Item 3, the dispute codes, applies from 2026-11-18.
Identity: the email's 'three goes?' is overridden by policy 2.1. The check fails at the second wrong answer in total, so max_wrong is 2.
Postcode length varies, so no fixed length is set. The year of birth is four digits (kind year).
The verify tool returns no hint field, so hints is empty. Unreadable answers return ok=false and are not counted; no special reject_values are needed.

Floor sample checks: card arrears 150 gives 22.50, rounded up to 25, minimum 30, so 30. Card arrears 200 gives exactly 30, so 30. Card arrears 20 gives 3, then 5, then 30, capped at the arrears, so 20. Card arrears 1000 gives 150, already a multiple of 5. Overdraft arrears 300 gives 75, rounded up to 80 (25%); after the memo it gives 60 (20%), which stays 60. Overdraft arrears 40 gives a floor of 40 (capped at the arrears).
Personal loan floor: the instalment in bands A and B. In band C the full arrears (floor_full_types), as the email's 'full stop' is overridden by policy 2.4.
Band C has no upper bound; max is set to 100000.
Band B: when today is the last business day of the month or later, the deadline rolls to the last business day of the following month (roll_if_not_after_today).

Ladder: the opening ask (full arrears today) is attempt 1, so it is ladder step 1. It is followed by: full on the 2nd business day, full on the deadline, and the floor on the deadline. Band attempt limits are copied as 3/4/3, including the opening. As a result, bands A and C end before the floor step: in band C, step 3 repeats step 2 because the deadline is the 2nd business day, and it is skipped but still uses an attempt.
Hardship goes direct to the Care queue and writes no notes. The hardship event therefore closes as handed_over/hardship with no note.
The brief gives no close reason for a system failure. service_error closes as no_promise with reason 'service_error' and note N-SYS (assumed code).

Third-party, callback, wrong-number, deceased and unclear handling are not described in the pack. The default callback settings are used, and these close as not_reached with assumed reasons named after the event.
max_unclear, confirm.max_asks, human.ask_first, max_not_talk, date_rules and callback defaults are not stated in the pack; the defaults are used.
Floor spoken name: the pack only says 'floor'. 'minimum payment' is used for all product types.
No exact wording is prescribed by the pack. Lines are written plainly, and no SMS line is required.
